_comment: Copy to pricing.local.json to correct or extend cost estimation. Everything here is optional and merges over the built-in tables in pricing.py; nothing is replaced wholesale. Only backfilled rows are estimated - where Claude Code reported a cost, that figure wins regardless.
_prices: Rates in USD per million tokens, [input, output], keyed by provider then by canonical model id (the plain Anthropic form: Bedrock and Vertex decoration is stripped before lookup). Longest-prefix match, so 'claude-opus-4-5' covers 'claude-opus-4-5-20251101'. The built-in Bedrock and Vertex tables are copies of Anthropic list prices, which is an assumption: Bedrock rates vary by region, batch is discounted, and Provisioned Throughput bills per model-unit-hour rather than per token. Paste your own region's rate card here.
_model_aliases: Raw model id -> canonical id. A Bedrock application inference profile or provisioned-model ARN names a deployment, not a model, so nothing in the id says which model it serves. Those are reported as unpriced until mapped here.
_unsplit_cache_multiplier: Multiple of the input rate charged for cache-creation tokens whose TTL the transcript did not record. Claude Code uses 1h caching (2.0) against the Anthropic API; set 1.25 for a provider offering only the 5-minute tier.
